title: When the Trail Breaks
author: Rafael Delacroix
blurb: Freya Pemberton, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
